rationale: Intermediate note, no record change. I began measuring the completion half of the read-index behaviour with a seventh test function: a leader is elected while its append acknowledgement is withheld, so it has no commit in its own term, a ReadIndex request is accepted and produces no read state (observed: state StateLeader, term 2, commit 10, read_states 0), and then the follower acknowledges the term-2 entry. That last step did not release the request in my probe, and the reason is in the code I had already cited: in ReadOnlySafe mode the release path registers the request and then broadcasts a heartbeat carrying the read context, and a read state is produced only when a quorum of heartbeat responses for that context arrives, so a two-node probe that drops the release-time heartbeats cannot complete it. The corrected probe needs one more round trip (deliver the release heartbeats to the follower and feed its responses back) before it is worth filing, so this turn changes nothing rather than filing a harness whose release half cannot complete.
